import html # Predefined HTML structure for a blog post with placeholders BLOG_FORMAT = """

{title}

{body}
""" def create_blog_post(heading: str, text: str) -> str: """ Prepare a blog post for safe web display. Parameters ---------- heading : str The main headline or subject of the blog post. text : str The complete textual content of the blog post. Returns ------- str A sanitized and HTML-formatted blog post ready for rendering. Raises ------ TypeError If either heading or text is not a string. """ if not isinstance(heading, str): raise TypeError("heading must be a string") if not isinstance(text, str): raise TypeError("text must be a string") # Escape any special HTML characters to prevent injection attacks safe_title = html.escape(heading, quote=True) # For the body we also escape but preserve newlines as
for readability safe_body = html.escape(text, quote=True).replace('\n', '
') # Construct the final HTML using the predefined format formatted_post = BLOG_FORMAT.format(title=safe_title, body=safe_body) return formatted_post
